name: Compliance (muṭāwaʿa)
definition: The meaning of a pattern that shows the object of another verb yielding to it: 'I broke it, and it broke'. Several augmented patterns have it, infaʿala and tafaʿʿala above all.
body: Kasara, 'he broke', has the compliant inkasara, 'it broke'; kassara, 'he shattered', has takassara, 'it shattered'; daḥraja, 'he rolled it', has tadaḥraja, 'it rolled'. The compliant verb is intransitive, since its subject is what the first verb acted on. Al-ʿIzzī and al-Maqṣūd list muṭāwaʿa among the meanings of the augmented patterns.

examples.text: kasara, inkasara: he broke it, and it broke (infaʿala).
kassara, takassara: he shattered it, and it shattered (tafaʿʿala).
daḥraja, tadaḥraja: the four-letter verb and its compliant.
